verdict.rationale: Runloop documents controls for Devbox automatic shutdown and idle behavior. It also supports suspend/resume that preserves state so work can continue "exactly where you left off," for example while waiting on PR feedback. Axons let agents suspend when idle, wake on demand and recover state, which suits long agent tasks. Missing for 10: any explicit statement of maximum session duration or support for continuously running sessions of hours or days, specifics of the shutdown/keep-alive configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running sessions.
